candidates.title: Howl's Moving Castle
candidates.plot: When an unconfident young woman is cursed with an old body by a spiteful witch, her only chance of breaking the spell lies with a self-indulgent yet insecure young wizard and his companions in his legged, walking castle.

candidates.title: Beetlejuice
candidates.plot: The spirits of a deceased couple are harassed by an unbearable family that has moved into their home, and hire a malicious spirit to drive them out.

candidates.title: Corpse Bride
candidates.plot: When a shy groom practices his wedding vows in the inadvertent presence of a deceased young woman, she rises from the grave assuming he has married her.

candidates.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
candidates.plot: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with the lives she could have led.

candidates.title: The Batman
candidates.plot: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

candidates.title: Top Gun: Maverick
candidates.plot: The story involves Maverick confronting his past while training a group of younger Top Gun graduates, including the son of his deceased best friend, for a dangerous mission.

candidates.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
candidates.plot: Deadpool is offered a place in the Marvel Cinematic Universe by the Time Variance Authority, but instead recruits a variant of Wolverine to save his universe from extinction.

candidates.title: Anora
candidates.plot: A young stripper from Brooklyn meets and impulsively marries the son of a Russian oligarch. Once the news reaches Russia, her fairy tale is threatened as his parents set out for New York to get the marriage annulled.

candidates.title: The Substance
candidates.plot: A fading celebrity takes a black-market drug: a cell-replicating substance that helps her create a younger, better version of herself.

candidates.title: Poor Things
candidates.plot: An account of the fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life by the brilliant and unorthodox scientist Dr. Godwin Baxter.

candidates.title: Barbenheimer
candidates.plot: Ken hires Oppenheimer to make a weapon of mass destruction to kill his rival, Ken, who is stealing his Barbie.

candidates.title: Wonka
candidates.plot: With dreams of opening a shop in a city renowned for its chocolate, a young and poor Willy Wonka discovers that the industry is run by a cartel of greedy chocolatiers.

candidates.title: Dune: Part Two
candidates.plot: Paul Atreides unites with the Fremen while on a warpath of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible fu...

candidates.title: A Minecraft Movie
candidates.plot: Four misfits are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into a bizarre cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home they'll have to master this world while embarking on a quest with an unexpected expert craf...

candidates.title: Sinners
candidates.plot: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

candidates.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
candidates.plot: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront.

candidates.title: Weapons
candidates.plot: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

candidates.title: One Battle After Another
candidates.plot: When their enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.

candidates.title: Wicked: For Good
candidates.plot: Elphaba, the future Wicked Witch of the West and her relationship with Glinda, the Good Witch of the North. The second of a two-part feature film adaptation of the Broadway musical.

candidates.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
candidates.plot: Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns to finish what was previously started, Jake must work with Neytiri and the army of the Na'vi race to protect their home.

candidates.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
candidates.plot: With Spider-Man's identity now revealed, Peter asks Doctor Strange for help. When a spell goes wrong, dangerous foes from other worlds start to appear.

candidates.title: The Godfather
candidates.plot: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

candidates.title: Pulp Fiction
candidates.plot: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

candidates.title: Casablanca
candidates.plot: A cynical expatriate American cafe owner struggles to decide whether or not to help his former lover and her fugitive husband escape the Nazis in French Morocco.

candidates.title: Schindler's List
candidates.plot: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

candidates.title: The Lion King
candidates.plot: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

candidates.title: Jaws
candidates.plot: When a massive killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Long Island, it's up to the local police chief, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.

candidates.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
candidates.plot: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape from Earth and return to his home planet.

candidates.title: Back to the Future
candidates.plot: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

candidates.title: Rocky
candidates.plot: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a supremely rare chance to fight the world heavyweight champion in a bout in which he strives to go the distance for his self-respect.

candidates.title: The Departed
candidates.plot: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.

candidates.title: No Time to Die
candidates.plot: James Bond has left active service. His peace is short-lived when Felix Leiter, an old friend from the CIA, turns up asking for help, leading Bond onto the trail of a mysterious villain armed with dangerous new technology.

candidates.title: Whiplash
candidates.plot: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

candidates.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
candidates.plot: A writer encounters the owner of an aging high-class hotel, who tells him of his early years serving as a lobby boy in the hotel's glorious years under an exceptional concierge.

candidates.title: Coco
candidates.plot: Aspiring musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather, a legendary singer.

candidates.title: Up
candidates.plot: 78-year-old Carl Fredricksen travels to South America in his house equipped with balloons, inadvertently taking a young stowaway.

candidates.title: Inside Out
candidates.plot: After young Riley is uprooted from her Midwest life and moved to San Francisco, her emotions, Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust, and Sadness, conflict on how best to navigate a new city, house, and school.

candidates.title: Toy Story
candidates.plot: A cowboy doll is profoundly jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as the top toy in a boy's bedroom. When circumstances separate them from their owner, the duo have to put aside their differences to return to him.

candidates.title: Frozen
candidates.plot: Fearless optimist Anna teams up with rugged mountain man Kristoff and his loyal reindeer Sven in an epic journey to find Anna's sister Elsa, whose icy powers have trapped the kingdom of Arendelle in eternal winter.

candidates.title: Zootopia
candidates.plot: In a city of anthropomorphic animals, a rookie bunny cop and a cynical con artist fox must work together to uncover a conspiracy.
candidates.director: Jared Bush, Byron Howard, Rich Moore
